name: no-expansion
why: Unasked, the output is a banner and nothing else — no per-item destination, no remediation steps, no closing summary. Layer 1 catches prose outside the banner; the judge catches expansion smuggled into the item lines.
seed: We decided this session to cache upstream responses for five minutes, on the grounds that the upstream rate limit is the real constraint. That reasoning is not written down. I also put the TTL constant into src/retry.ts, uncommitted.

items.about: the five-minute response caching decision and its rate-limit rationale, not written down
the TTL constant added to src/retry.ts, uncommitted

forbid: step-by-step instructions for saving an item, such as a git command to run or a file to create
a closing summary, next-steps list, or offer of further help after the banner
